id: Summer Holiday Market-Mangaroa Farm, 98 Whitemans Valley Road, Te Awa Kairangi, Upper Hutt-Mangaroa
name: Summer Holiday Market
venue: Mangaroa Farm, 98 Whitemans Valley Road, Te Awa Kairangi, Upper Hutt
long_description:
Join Mangaroa Farms for our very first holiday market. We're celebrating the gift of summer by connecting our local community around food, gardening and artisan goods. We'll also be relaunching Pick Your Own as the summer veges spring up, and our coffee cart will be open. Come down for a day in the sun with family and friends.

Featuring
- Goods from local makers, growers and vendors
- Mangaroa Coffee Cart, open from 9am-1pm
- Crop & seedling swap
- Pick Your Own Veges

Please park on the paddock to the right of the regular Farm Shop carpark.

Please email events@mangaroa.org for more information, or if you'd like to participate.

id: Mangaroa Farms Harvest Festival-Mangaroa Farm, 98 Whitemans Valley Road, Te Awa Kairangi, Upper Hutt-Mangaroa
name: Mangaroa Farms Harvest Festival
venue: Mangaroa Farm, 98 Whitemans Valley Road, Te Awa Kairangi, Upper Hutt
long_description:
Join us on Saturday 10 April from 10am–3pm for our Harvest Festival — celebrating Upper Hutt Food Week (3–11 April) with a day of farm charm. Expect local kai, garden and orchard tours, a kids zone, market stalls, coffee, live music, educational workshops, sheep shearing and dog demos, our pumpkin competition, the local walking trail and more.

More details to come - we look forward to seeing you in autumn.
